records.label: Edit an existing taxonomy (Categories, Tags, or one registered by a theme or plugin such as product categories)
records.notes: JetEngine "Edit built-in post types and taxonomies" (https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/); Toolset Types and ACPT edit built-in and third-party post types and taxonomies. Stored as an override of the registered object (register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args), never as a new registration; reverting removes the override and restores the original arguments. Hook: register_taxonomy_args (https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/hooks/register_taxonomy_args/).

records.label: Rename an existing taxonomy and change its menu and admin column display
records.notes: JetEngine "Edit built-in post types and taxonomies" (https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/). Labels, show_admin_column and show_in_menu via register_taxonomy_args. Stored as an override of the registered object (register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args), never as a new registration; reverting removes the override and restores the original arguments.

records.label: Attach an existing taxonomy to more post types or detach it
records.notes: register_taxonomy_for_object_type() / unregister_taxonomy_for_object_type() (https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/functions/unregister_taxonomy_for_object_type/). Example: Categories on Pages, Tags removed from Posts.

records.label: Change visibility and URLs of an existing taxonomy (public, hierarchical display, rewrite slug, REST exposure, tag cloud, quick edit)
records.notes: JetEngine "Edit built-in post types and taxonomies" (https://crocoblock.com/knowledge-base/jetengine/); register_taxonomy_args. Stored as an override of the registered object (register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args), never as a new registration; reverting removes the override and restores the original arguments.

records.label: Hide or disable Tags or Categories with terms kept
records.notes: Market: "Disable Tags/Categories" plugins. Hides UI, meta box and REST; terms and relationships stay in the database.

records.label: Revert an existing taxonomy to its original registration and show what is overridden
records.notes: Per-setting and full revert with original values shown.

coverage.notes: Gap closure 2026-11-20: editing, hiding and reverting objects WordPress, themes or other plugins already register.
